items.title: 8.6 Podon mein ghiza ki naqal (translocation) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.6, printed pages 187-189.

blocks.text: Phloem podon ka woh vascular tissue hai jo organic nutrients, khaas taur par photosynthesis se bani cheezon (jaise sugar), ko patton se pode ke un hisson tak le jata hai jahan un ki zaroorat ho ya jahan unhen zakheera (store) kiya jata hai. Jin podon mein secondary growth hoti hai, un mein phloem aam taur par primary aur secondary dono vascular tissues ke bahar wali taraf hota hai. Phloem andar wali chhaal (inner bark) banata hai.
Phloem mein sieve elements, companion cells, phloem fibres aur phloem parenchyma hote hain (Fig. 8.10).

blocks.alt: Phloem ka lambai mein kata hissa. Baen se: patle Phloem fibre cells; nucleus aur vacuole wale Phloem Parenchyma cells ka sutoon; chaura Sieve Tube Cell jis ke paar do Sieve Plates hain jin mein Sieve Pores hain; aur sieve tube ke pehlu mein patle dukla-numa Companion Cells, ek mein nucleus.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.10: Phloem tissue ke mukhtalif hisse (kitab ki Figure 8.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sieve tube cells siron se jur kar lambi nali banate hain; beech ki sieve plates ke surakhon (sieve pores) se sugar wala mahlool aage jata hai. Sieve tube cell ka apna nucleus nahin hota, is liye saath wala companion cell use ATP aur proteins deta hai. Parenchyma zakheera karta hai aur fibres sahara dete hain.

Phloem ke jo cells sugars aur doosra organic mawad poore pode mein le jate hain unhen sieve tube elements (ya sieve tube cells) kehte hain. Sieve tube elements mein 'sieve areas' hote hain, yani cell wall ke woh hisse jahan surakh (pores) ek sieve tube element ko doosre se jorte hain. Kuch sieve areas sieve tube elements ki aakhri deewaron (end walls) mein bante hain, jahan alag alag cells sira-ba-sira jur kar ek lambi qatar banate hain jise sieve tube kehte hain. Har sieve tube element ke saath ek ya zyada companion cells hote hain. Sieve tube elements aur companion cells plasmodesmata ke zariye aapas mein rabta rakhte hain. Companion cells sieve tube elements ko ATP aur proteins dete hain. Phloem parenchyma sugars, resins (raal), latex (doodh jaisa ras) aur mucilage (lesdar madda) jaisi cheezein zakheera karta hai, jo pode ke difa (defence) aur nami (moisture) qaim rakhne ke liye aham hain.
Podon mein sugars ki naqal o hamal (transport) phloem tissue ke zariye hoti hai. Phloem transport ki passive (baghair energy ke) theories yeh hain:

Diffusion bohat hi sust hai; is se phloem mein sugar ki raftar samajh nahin aati. Phloem mein sugar ausatan 1 metre fi ghanta chalti hai, jab ke diffusion se 1 metre ka faasla aath (8) saal mein tai hota hai.

Pressure flow theory: pressure-flow theory, jise mass-flow hypothesis bhi kehte hain, phloem ke zariye sugars ki naqal ki sab se zyada mani hui wazahat hai. Translocation sugar ko source (jahan sugar banti hai) se sink (jahan sugar istemal hoti ya zakheera hoti hai) tak le jati hai. Yeh theory Ernst Münch ne 1930 mein pesh ki. Yeh theory source aur sink ke darmiyan osmotic pressure ke farq par mabni hai. Neeche ke qadam (steps) pressure-flow theory ko samjhate hain.

items: Mesophyll cells mein photosynthesis se bani glucose respiration mein istemal hoti hai. Bachi hui (zaid) glucose ek non-reducing sugar, yani sucrose, mein badal di jati hai.

Sucrose active transport se mesophyll cells se phloem ke companion cells mein bheji jati hai. Wahan se sucrose plasmodesmata ke zariye sieve tubes mein diffuse hoti hai. Is tarah sieve tubes mein sucrose ki concentration barh jati hai.

Sieve tubes mein sucrose (solute) zyada hone ki wajah se patte ke qareeb wale xylem se pani osmosis ke zariye sieve tubes mein aata hai. Kitab ke mutabiq is se sieve tubes ke source wale sire par water potential barh jata hai; asal mein yahan andar ka dabao (hydrostatic pressure) barhta hai.

Sink wale sire par sugar active transport se sieve tubes se nikal li jati hai (unloading) aur pani bhi osmosis se peeche peeche nikal jata hai. Pani nikalne se sink wale sire par water potential (yani dabao) kam ho jata hai. Is tarah source wale sire par zyada aur sink wale sire par kam hota hai.
Is farq ki wajah se pani source se sink ki taraf behta hai. Sucrose pani mein ghuli hui hai, is liye woh bhi pani ke saath source se sink tak chali jati hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Asal mein mahlool ko dhakelne wali cheez dabao ka farq hai: source par pani andar aane se sieve tube mein dabao (hydrostatic pressure) zyada hota hai aur sink par pani nikalne se kam. Figure 8.11 bhi yahi “higher hydrostatic pressure” aur “lower hydrostatic pressure” likh kar dikhati hai. Bilkul aise jaise pipe ke ek sire par dabao zyada ho to pani doosre sire ki taraf behta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen xylem ka sutoon aur beech mein phloem ki sieve tube; upar daen patta (sucrose ka source) apne companion cell ke saath, neeche daen phal (sucrose ka sink) apne companion cell ke saath; plasmodesmata companion cells ko sieve tube se jorte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.11: Pressure-flow theory (kitab ki Figure 8.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Baen xylem ka sutoon aur beech mein phloem ki sieve tube; upar daen patta (sucrose ka source) apne companion cell ke saath, neeche daen phal (sucrose ka sink) apne companion cell ke saath; plasmodesmata companion cells ko sieve tube se jorte hain. Number: 1 patte mein sugar banti hai; 2 sucrose faal naqal se companion cell aur sieve tube mein; 3 xylem se osmosis ke zariye pani sieve tube mein (zyada hydrostatic pressure); 4 phal mein sucrose ka utarna aur pani ka peecha karna (kam hydrostatic pressure); 5 sieve tube mein mahlool ka bulk flow. Key: water, sucrose, osmosis, active transport of sucrose.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Numbers ko kitab ke paanch qadmon se milayein. Source (patta) ki taraf sucrose zyada hai, is liye pani osmosis se sieve tube mein aa kar dabao (hydrostatic pressure) barhata hai. Sink (phal) ki taraf sucrose nikal jata hai, pani bhi nikal jata hai aur dabao kam ho jata hai. Dabao ke is farq se poora mahlool source se sink ki taraf beh nikalta hai (bulk flow).

blocks.prompt: Pressure-flow theory mein dono siron par active transport kyun chahiye, jab ke beech ka bahao passive hai?
blocks.explanation: Source par active loading sieve tube mein sucrose barhati hai, taake pani andar aaye aur dabao bane. Sink par active unloading sucrose nikal deti hai, taake pani bahar jaye aur dabao gire. Inhi do qadmon se dabao ka farq banta hai, aur yahi farq beech mein mahlool ko passive mass flow ke zariye source se sink tak, taqreeban 1 metre fi ghanta ki raftar se, chalata hai.

items: Phloem (inner bark) photosynthesis ki bani cheezein le jata hai: sieve tube elements (sieve areas se jur kar sieve tube), companion cells (plasmodesmata se ATP aur proteins dete hain), phloem fibres aur parenchyma (sugars, resins, latex, mucilage ka zakheera).

Diffusion bohat sust hai (1 metre fi ghanta ke muqable mein 1 metre aath saal mein). Münch ki pressure-flow theory (1930): source par sucrose load, pani andar, dabao zyada; sink par sucrose unload, pani bahar, dabao kam; mahlool sucrose samet source se sink ki taraf behta hai.
